calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members,
       COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, MIN(valid_from) AS min_vf, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT MAX(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join,
       (SELECT MAX(valid_from) FROM dim_member) AS max_valid_from,
       (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) > 1)) AS members_multi_join_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS joined_0310,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND home_store_id = 900) AS online_0310,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND NOT is_current) AS noncurrent_rows,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS stg_count
